description: DONE (ae1f3f123, two-lane audited PASS/PASS 2026-07-03). The RootBackendProduct pull-drive's four ProductDriveError failure hooks (no_ready_producer, fact_wait_budget_exceeded, did_not_settle, job_failed) are now proven WIRED end-to-end, not just formatted: 8 new tests drive drive_root_backend_product itself into each hook through real front-door input and assert the surfaced String message / FatalError diagnostic with the right interpolated root/fact/job. All four hooks reachable (audit-confirmed twice): no_ready_producer = root referencing an undefined function (SeedRoot claims RootEntry pre-block so it isn't re-demanded, the Recursive keying wait drains empty); job_failed = a Runtime root targeting a defmacro entry (seed_root rejects RootKind::Runtime+is_macro, the sole public root kind); budget hooks via a test-only inner seam drive_root_backend_product_with_budgets(product_stack_budget, fact_wait_budget) that the production wrapper always calls with PRODUCT_DRIVE_BUDGET for both (byte-identical production behavior — audit-verified; budget=0/3 hits the identical production comparison, just early). All 8 mutation-proven to bite (each template corruption reddens exactly its test). At fold: PRODUCT_DRIVE_BUDGET + the inner fn narrowed pub(crate)->pub(super) (matches job_budget_guard.rs/source_test.rs precedent). Test-redundancy + add1_world helper follow-up filed.
title: Production-path coverage for ProductDriveError failure hooks
